name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless Credit Card
signup_bonus: Three free-night awards after $3,000 in eligible purchases within 3 months of account opening. Each award covers a night costing up to 50,000 points; resort fees may apply.
perks: Earn 6 card points per dollar at participating Marriott hotels; membership and status can earn additional points.
Earn 3 points per dollar on the first $6,000 in combined grocery, gas and dining purchases annually; 2 on other purchases.
audit_note: Only the facts shown below were confirmed at the linked official source. Other terms remain unverified; offers may change or vary by applicant.
